# Plain language

## Directives

From [Digital product development](digital-product-development.md):

- Name the user and the task of each feature before you design or build the feature. ^name-user-and-task

## Definition

Writing that its intended readers can easily find, understand, and use. ISO 24495-1 sets the governing principles and the guidelines for plain language documents. It applies to printed or digital information that is mainly text, including technical writing.
